At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
Your role will be instrumental in designing the next generation of Affirm’s Checkout Platform to provide a world-class buying experience that puts customers first!
We are seeking a Backend Software Engineer to build out financial products and features providing new levels of accessibility and flexibility to our users. You will work in a fast-paced team environment, designing and implementing new API’s and microservice interfaces to manage every users’ transaction with Affirm. You will also use your technical skillset to find opportunities to improve the performance and reliability of the systems that drive the user journey through purchasing with Affirm.
Come join us as we build a beloved, lasting financial services brand predicated on honesty and trust. It’s going to be an amazing ride!
What you'll do
Work with technical leaders in the team to design and implement insightful forward-looking approaches that go beyond the direct team and solve large open-ended problems
Actively own components of checkout systems and define their long-term health, while also improving the health of surrounding systems
Collaborate with engineers within our team and across the organization to build the next generation of the checkout platform
Learn and improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes across the checkout platform
What we look for
Take Ownership. You enjoy working with product and engineering leaders to develop detailed project definitions, and drive technical decisions within your team
Execute. You have a proven track record of developing, testing, and shipping high-quality software at scale
Collaborate. You communicate clearly both verbally and in writing. If anything, you trend towards over-communication
Build Teams. You grow with engineers around you through sharing your learnings and providing feedback to your peers that will help the team grow
Customer-centric mentality. You are empathetic to the user experience and thoughtful about what we can do to make it better
This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field
Tech You Will Use
Python
Kotlin
RPC
Redis
MySQL
AWS
Github
Base Pay Grade - L
Equity Grade - USA 6

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)
USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Junior Software Engineer to join our API Engineering team. In this role, you will help design, develop, test, document, and support REST APIs that power business applications, partner integrations, and client\-facing services.
   

  

 You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, product managers, quality engineers, and platform teams to learn and apply modern software engineering practices while contributing to secure, scalable, and reliable APIs. This position is ideal for an early\-career engineer who is eager to grow in backend development, systems integration, and API design, and who enjoys solving technical problems in a collaborative, mentorship\-driven environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 API Development
   

  

* Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Build and maintain reusable components, libraries, and integration services.
* Help ensure APIs meet performance, reliability, and security requirements.
* Learn and apply API versioning and lifecycle management practices.
* Troubleshoot and help resolve API and integration issues across development and testing environments, escalating complex issues as needed.


 Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing
   

  

* Create and maintain clear API and integration documentation, including API specifications, developer guides, and usage examples.
* Document technical work, implementation notes, and lessons learned.
* Contribute to team knowledge repositories and engineering best practices.


 Integration \& Architecture
   

  

* Support the development of integrations between internal systems, external partners, and cloud services.
* Follow enterprise architecture standards when implementing API solutions.
* Learn and contribute to microservices and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Assist with API gateway onboarding and basic policy implementation tasks.


 Quality Engineering
   

  

* Write unit, integration, and automated API tests with guidance from senior team members.
* Participate in peer code reviews and design reviews to learn team standards.
* Support CI/CD pipeline usage and basic deployment automation tasks.
* Help identify reliability, performance, and maintainability issues.


 Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Learn and apply secure authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth 2\.0 and JWT.
* Follow secure coding practices and enterprise security requirements.
* Support vulnerability remediation activities as directed.
* Help ensure appropriate logging and monitoring is implemented in the services you build.


 Collaboration
   

  

* Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and engineering planning activities.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, security, and operations teams.
* Communicate progress, questions, and technical ideas clearly to teammates and mentors.
* Seek feedback and apply it to continuously improve technical skills.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience, including internships, bootcamps, or personal projects).


**Experience**
* 0\-2 years of professional software development experience (internships, co\-ops, and academic projects are valued).
* Some exposure to building or consuming REST APIs, through coursework, internships, or personal projects.
* Familiarity with at least one backend language/framework such as Java, C\#, .NET, or Spring Boot.
* Basic experience with Git\-based source control.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Basic understanding of REST API principles and HTTP protocols.
* Familiarity with JSON and API integration concepts.
* Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
* Foundational knowledge of software design patterns and object\-oriented programming.
* Willingness to learn API security concepts, including OAuth 2\.0 and JWT.
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks (unit testing) is a plus.
* Interest in or coursework experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.
* Curiosity about containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Eagerness to learn CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving Microsoft Azure.
* Exposure to messaging or event\-driven concepts (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus).
* Experience writing basic technical documentation.
* Familiarity with monitoring/logging concepts.
* Internship or academic experience in financial services, fintech, or other regulated industries.


 What We Value
   

  

* Strong desire to learn and grow as a software engineer.
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Attention to detail and commitment to writing quality code.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and accept mentorship in a team environment.
* Growth mindset and willingness to adopt new technologies.
* Ownership mindset with the ability to drive assigned tasks to completion with support.


 Core Technologies
   

  

* REST APIs (foundational)
* Java, Spring Boot, C\#, or .NET
* Git
* SQL Databases
* Basic OAuth 2\.0 / JWT concepts


 Nice to Have Technologies
   

  

* Microsoft Azure
* Docker / Kubernetes (exposure)
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Kafka or similar messaging platforms


 Desired Traits
   

  

* Strong foundational engineering skills
* Eagerness to learn cloud\-native development
* Security\-aware mindset
* Good communication and documentation habits
* Ability to work effectively in Agile teams with mentorship
* Passion for building reliable software and growing into a stronger engineer


 Role Summary
   

  

 This job description is aligned for an entry\-level/junior engineer joining an Azure\-based REST API platform team. The role emphasizes hands\-on learning, mentorship, and gradual ownership of API development, integrations, testing, documentation, and cloud\-native application delivery under the guidance of senior engineers.
   

  

**Salary Range**
 $70,000 \- $118,750 Annual

**About This Role**
 About this Role:At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As an Backend Engineer, you’ll build resilient systems that power our global post\-trade operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise\-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices.This role is ideal for engineers who like to innovate and solve complex challenges while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA): A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high\-volume, real\-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business\-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities: Design and develop robust, high\-performance back\-end systems using Java 11\+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Take active part in design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands\-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event\-driven systems to process and distribute large\-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real\-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis\-based caching and data stores for low\-latency access patterns. Contribute end\-to\-end; when needed, take on lightweight UI updates, leveraging AI\-assisted coding tools and support from front\-end teammates. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Elevate technical craftsmanship, problem\-solving, and design thinking skills. Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes. Qualifications / Competencies: B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 4\+ years of professional experience in Java and object\-oriented design. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands\-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish\-subscribe systems for real\-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Familiarity with Front End technologies (Angular or React; JavaScript/TypeScript; HTML/CSS) is preferred. Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication Nice to Have: Experience with Enterprise\-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, or cloud\-native environments (AWS/GCP). Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. Exposure to Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology. **Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all.
